name: Unidentified GR-75 medium transport
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Invasion of Yavin 4)
description: During the late stages of the Galactic Empire's Attack on Yavin 4, a GR-75 medium transport aided in evacuating the Rebel leader, General Jan Dodonna, as well as Red Squadron members, Commanders Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles.
